text_block_list.text: "Hurry up, Brian!"
text_block_list.name: Young Girl

text_block_list.text:
That dream again. I'm always chasing her in
it. Every step I take is so
satisfying. So
sweet. But...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: It's just a dream now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
There's a stir of excitement on the training
course, and one runner is
at the center of
it all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's Нарита Брайан. She hasn't debuted
yet, but just look at that
imposing
demeanor.
text_block_list.name: New Trainer

text_block_list.text:
I guess the rumors are true—she's
challenging prizewinners to
unofficial
races!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
How about we set the distance to
whatever you're best at? Which I'd
say is...
2,000 meters?
text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Can you offer a serious challenge at that
distance?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Sure, if it's against you. I'm the
experienced runner here, so it's only
fair I
give you a handicap. That's
non-negotiable if I'm going to
accept this
race.
text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Fine, if you insist.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Wooo! Hayahide, here! Over here! Brian's
race is starting!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Ticket. The volume of your
yelling is more than sufficient,
so would
you kindly lower it?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa—how could I keep quiet?! Her opponent today is super strong!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Brian's a tough cookie, but if she fails
big-time, she's gonna be
seriously bummed
out!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: She will not.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm more acquainted with Brian's ability
than anyone. I also know the
burden she
bears because of it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
(She's way ahead. Her hair and tail are
waving in the wind...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
(They say she races at the G1 level, so her
talent is no fluke. Which
means I don't
need... to hold back!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...There she is.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Waaagh! H-Hayahide! They're already past
the last turn, but look at
the gap between
them now...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Yes, Brian is far behind. Any normal runner
wouldn't be able to make
up that
distance...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: But she is no normal runner.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Thud, thud, thud!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the heck?! That speed is crazy!
She'll catch up at this rate!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Three lengths... Two lengths... Whoa, she's
already in passing range!
Geez, this Brian's
amazing!
text_block_list.name: New Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Agh... No way... I was in total control of
this race! How can a
pre-debut rookie...
possibly... catch up to me?!
text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume

text_block_list.text: (You're strong, all right.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
(So keep letting me chase you like this.
Don't let me pass you just
yet.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Whoosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(Show me all the fight that's in you. Maybe
then...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Wha?!
text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume

text_block_list.text: (It always happens right here...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Thud, thud... thud... thud...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(How many times have I seen this
moment—when the fire in their eyes
goes
out, swallowed up by darkness? Too many
to count...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан slowed down right before the
finish... I guess she ran out
of stamina at
the last moment.
text_block_list.name: New Trainer

text_block_list.text: Th-then the winner is...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Wheeze, pant... wheeze...
text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! What were you thinking
accepting a race without
talking to me
first?!
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text: I'm... s-sorry.
text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm impressed. She may be
inexperienced, but beating her in a

2,000-meter race is no small feat! You did
we—
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Stop, please. She's so much better than
me, it wasn't even a real
race... at all!
text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
That was no win! I should never... have
gone up against a beast like
that!
text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Whoa... What's up with this mood? How
come the winner isn't even a
little happy?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Because she saw it. When you experience
an insurmountable power
up close, what
you feel isn't excitement—it's fear.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
A beast who instills despair in everyone
she faces... That's Narita
Brian—my sister.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The race is over and an eerie silence falls
over what was, seconds
before, an exciting
competition.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's rumored even amongst trainers that her
talent is immeasurable.
That's why I came
here today—to see it for myself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But still, her race caught me off
guard—both in how she stalled out
after
that beautiful final sprint and the pained
look on her face after.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Maybe I can figure her out if we talk
face-to-face.

text_block_list.text:
In my time here, no encounter has ever
been as strange and confusing
as my first
experience seeing Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
